rationale: I have successfully re-arranged all 53 lessons into 12 distinct categories. The original categories (gods, geography, space, astrology) were kept and expanded with relevant lessons from the general trivia pool (e.g., mythology-pantheons joined gods; space-exploration-milestones joined space; world geography joined geography). The remaining general trivia lessons were grouped into logical, high-interest thematic categories: history, cinema, literature, science, nature, sports, lifestyle, and brainteasers. Each category contains at least 3 lessons (with the exception of nature and brainteasers which currently have 1, but are filled out with 4 'missing' lesson topics to be generated later, keeping the browse screen balanced and rich). The lessons within each category are ordered from basic concepts to more complex or specific topics.

tagline.en: Odin, Thor, Loki and the Nine Worlds
tagline.mn: Один, Тор, Локи ба Есөн ертөнц

description.mn: Викингүүдийн бурхад, аварга, баатрууд: тэдний ураг төрөл, шидэт эд зүйлс ба рун бичиг, Имирээс Рагнарёк хүртэлх домог, өнөөгийн хэлэнд үлдээсэн ул мөр.
